const QUESTION_LINE: u32 = line!() + 2;
fn via_question_mark() -> Result<(), $ROOT> {
    Err::<(), _>(::std::io::Error::from(::std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied))?;
    Ok(())
}

fn chain<'a>(error: &'a (dyn ::std::error::Error + 'static)) -> Vec<&'a (dyn ::std::error::Error + 'static)> {
    let mut result = vec![error];
    let mut current = error;
    while let Some(source) = current.source() {
        result.push(source);
        current = source;
    }
    result
}

fn main() {
    baseline_main();

    // Each propagation moves the whole source wrapper. Its existing boxed Kind,
    // native payload, and creation context survive the new caller's frame.
    let leaf_line = line!() + 1;
    let leaf = $IO_FAMILY::from(::std::io::Error::from(::std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound));
    let kind_address = leaf.kind.as_ref() as *const _;
    let pair_line = line!() + 1;
    let pair = $PAIR::from(leaf);
    let triple_line = line!() + 1;
    let triple = $TRIPLE::from(pair);
    let root_line = line!() + 1;
    let root = $ROOT::from(triple);
    let frames = chain(&root);
    assert_eq!(frames.len(), 6);
    let triple = frames[1].downcast_ref::<$TRIPLE>().unwrap();
    let pair = frames[2].downcast_ref::<$PAIR>().unwrap();
    let leaf = frames[3].downcast_ref::<$IO_FAMILY>().unwrap();
    let native = frames[4].downcast_ref::<$IO_SOURCE>().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(leaf.kind.as_ref() as *const _, kind_address);
    for (file, actual, expected) in [
        (root.file.as_str(), root.line, root_line),
        (triple.file.as_str(), triple.line, triple_line),
        (pair.file.as_str(), pair.line, pair_line),
        (leaf.file.as_str(), leaf.line, leaf_line),
        (native.file.as_str(), native.line, leaf_line),
    ] {
        assert_eq!(file, file!());
        assert_eq!(actual, expected);
    }
    assert_eq!(native.source.kind(), ::std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound);
    assert_eq!(
        frames[5].downcast_ref::<::std::io::Error>().unwrap().kind(),
        ::std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound
    );
    let display = root.to_string();
    assert!(display.contains(file!()));
    for line in [leaf_line, pair_line, triple_line, root_line] {
        assert!(display.contains(&format!(":{line}")));
    }

    // A bare ? uses the unique native-to-root route and forwards caller context
    // through each generated From implementation, rather than std's map_err.
    let error = via_question_mark().unwrap_err();
    let frames = chain(&error);
    assert_eq!(frames.len(), 6);
    for (file, line) in [
        (&error.file, error.line),
        (&frames[1].downcast_ref::<$TRIPLE>().unwrap().file, frames[1].downcast_ref::<$TRIPLE>().unwrap().line),
        (&frames[2].downcast_ref::<$PAIR>().unwrap().file, frames[2].downcast_ref::<$PAIR>().unwrap().line),
        (&frames[3].downcast_ref::<$IO_FAMILY>().unwrap().file, frames[3].downcast_ref::<$IO_FAMILY>().unwrap().line),
        (&frames[4].downcast_ref::<$IO_SOURCE>().unwrap().file, frames[4].downcast_ref::<$IO_SOURCE>().unwrap().line),
    ] {
        assert_eq!(file, file!());
        assert_eq!(line, QUESTION_LINE);
    }
    assert_eq!(frames[5].downcast_ref::<::std::io::Error>().unwrap().kind(), ::std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied);

    let parse_line = line!() + 1;
    let parse = $ROOT::from("bad".parse::<u32>().unwrap_err());
    let frames = chain(&parse);
    assert_eq!(frames.len(), 5);
    assert_eq!(frames[3].downcast_ref::<$PARSE_SOURCE>().unwrap().line, parse_line);
    assert_eq!(frames[4].downcast_ref::<::std::num::ParseIntError>().unwrap().kind(), &::std::num::IntErrorKind::InvalidDigit);

    let invalid = [0xff];
    let utf8_line = line!() + 1;
    let utf8 = $ROOT::from(::std::str::from_utf8(::std::hint::black_box(&invalid)).unwrap_err());
    let frames = chain(&utf8);
    assert_eq!(frames.len(), 4);
    assert_eq!(frames[2].downcast_ref::<$UTF8_SOURCE>().unwrap().line, utf8_line);
    let native = frames[3].downcast_ref::<::std::str::Utf8Error>().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(native.valid_up_to(), 0);
    assert_eq!(native.error_len(), Some(1));

    let expected = "bad".parse::<f32>().unwrap_err();
    let float_line = line!() + 1;
    let float = $ROOT::from(expected.clone());
    let frames = chain(&float);
    assert_eq!(frames.len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(frames[1].downcast_ref::<$FLOAT_SOURCE>().unwrap().line, float_line);
    assert_eq!(frames[2].downcast_ref::<::std::num::ParseFloatError>(), Some(&expected));

    println!("nested sources, contexts and native payloads preserved");
}
